'''Torphceris''' was the last [[Argazdan/Legends|Argazdan]] [[Argazdan Regent|Regent]] of the [[Argazdan Redoubt]] during the last [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Kanz Disorders/Legends|Kanz Disorders]] leading up to the [[Myrialites]] defeat in [[3670 BBY]]

==Biography==
Around [[3670 BBY]], Torphceris's grip over the [[Argazdan Redoubt]] was threatened by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] under the [[Lorrdian/Legends|Lorrdian]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mari-Elan Nora]]. In desperation, he betrayed his "beliefs" in [[Vianism]] by making a pact with a demonic [[Unidentified female Yuuzhan Vong Shaper|alien "artisan-shaper"]].

The [[Yuuzhan Vong|alien]] had come to the known [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] from the [[Intergalactic Void]] and displayed much expertise in bioengineering. Torphceris used the alien's expertise to create a bioengineered monster which was buried beneath the [[Slave Pits of Lorrd]]. These pits were constructed at the cost of the lives of thousands of Lorrdian [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]].

Following the defeat of the Myrialites, he may have been killed in the conflict or imprisoned and tried by the Republic. During the last years of the Galactic Republic, a [[Torphceris (play)|play]] named after him was made about his role in the construction of the Slave Pits by the Lorrdian playwright [[Pordi zet Chatc]]. However, he was not portrayed as a villain, but rather as a coward willing to surrender his beliefs for power.
